title: CrossPlot Harness Reliability
acceptance: Touch is proven with an unguarded, enabled probe seat (up to 3 tries); if it never seats A, the parked-seat check is recorded as inconclusive (run flagged infra), never as a pass or a game failure.
The enabled-seat guard is tested deterministically: the server seats A in B's enabled front seat and A is ejected within about 1 s.
Negative control: with the owner-seat guard disabled in Studio's copy only, the AC2 check fails.
CrossPlot passes 3 of 3 runs with both clients joined; runs where the 2nd client doesn't join are logged as infra and not counted. No TrainService or ownership changes.
